title: Private-IP guard checks the whole URL string, so internal hosts and cloud metadata are reachable
reason: The url tool argument is passed whole (e.g. `http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/`) to is_ip_private, which tests whether a string is a private IP, not the URL's host, so it does not match and the request goes out; hostnames like `localhost` or a DNS name pointing at 127.0.0.1 and redirects to internal addresses are never checked either. A prompt-injected call can read internal services and cloud metadata and return them to the model.
fix: Parse with new URL(url), allow only http/https, resolve the hostname (dns.lookup all addresses) and reject private/loopback/link-local/IPv6-local ranges, fetch with redirect: 'manual' and re-check each Location hop (or pin the resolved IP via a custom undici dispatcher).

title: Fetched web content returned unmarked into the model context

evidence.quote: return { content: [{ type: "text", text: html }], isError: false };

reason: Every tool returns arbitrary third-party page content verbatim to the model, which is how injected instructions on a web page reach the agent (and combined with M001 can steer it to internal URLs).
fix: Wrap returned content in clear untrusted-data delimiters and document that clients should not auto-approve follow-up actions based on fetched content.

title: Whole response body is read into memory before max_length is applied
reason: max_length only truncates after the full body is downloaded; a URL to a huge or endless response can exhaust memory or hang the server (no timeout either).
fix: Stream the body and stop after max_length+start_index bytes, and pass an AbortSignal.timeout() to fetch.
